deviation_from_protocol: PROTOCOL.md section 6 specifies auditing against the disclosed validation split (872 rows). This audit instead uses a disclosed, seeded slice of the TRAIN split, to avoid computing an accuracy-flavored statistic against the validation split before it is used for the one official scoring run. See this script's module docstring and authoring/RATIONALE.md for the full reasoning.

audit_slice.construction: scripts.eval_common.reserve_slices -- first AUDIT_SLICE_SIZE rows of a seeded permutation of all TRAIN row indices

mismatch_criterion: mismatch_found = (direct-convention accuracy on the audit slice) < 0.5 -- pre-registered, no magnitude threshold, no example cherry-picking

direct_convention.description: predict label 1 (positive) iff predict_proba(sentence) > 0.5, as the frozen net's forward pass was authored to assume

flipped_convention.description: complement of the direct prediction -- what accuracy would be if label 1 actually meant negative in this release

labels_seen_this_revision.note: Applies only to this audit's own reported numbers. Per PROTOCOL.md section 6, this is never folded into the frozen, zero-label labels_seen=0 result for the hand-written net itself.
